content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Durham

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a specific combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects—to ensure you qualify before enrolling. Granite PM Academy can guide you through this verification process.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers all five process groups and knowledge areas tested on the exam. Classes fit working professionals' schedules across the Durham region and beyond.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your education credentials and project-experience hours. Pay the associated PMI exam fee to complete registration. Granite PM Academy will walk you through the submission steps.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce bootcamp concepts. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center near you, then sit for the four-hour assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, you'll maintain it across a three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your certification current.
